description: Ministry of Justice and Labour Relations - Order to be carried out the Settlement of disputes relating to the possession or ownership of Lands in Administrative District of Jaffna & 04 others
categorisation: This gazette content is an order made under the Mediation (Special Categories of Disputes) Act, No. 21 of 2003, specifying areas for the settlement of land disputes. It constitutes a regulatory action and legal notice issued under existing legislation, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette (Type 5). While it mentions a minister's name, this is in the context of exercising statutory powers rather than a personnel appointment or detailed portfolio description, so government classification types do not take precedence.
